contributions.root_integration: Independently reviewed cancellation fixes, recovery cutoff reporting, complete build and integrated verification.

scope.architecture: Extract stock- and selected-producer-dependent material equivalence into a request-local, immutable identity index; keep original producer tables available to exact continuation.

terminal_optimizer.acceptance: Strictly fewer executions, exact material replay and the existing objective. Runs after the established portfolio and shares its remaining work and 32-probe allowance.
exclusions: Returned inputs, remainders and host-private inventory

correctness: Bound cancellation in explicit footprint metadata/input scans and reject cancellation before index publication.
Bound cancellation in material-replay side-output construction and Kahn fanout/ready scans.
Mark the original missing witness and search diagnostics only when small recovery actually receives a shared-work refusal.

existing_identity_order_variation.note: Both pre-existing outcomes occur in both versions. Equal-share allocation repair follows identity-map iteration; no new heuristic or tie order was introduced.

terminal_oracle_scope: Finite two-terminal-resource families with 17/24/32/48/64 recipes. Rows are emitted only when the independent DP finds a certificate within 12 firings. Unemitted graphs are not claimed infeasible. Optimizer refines feasible plans only.

original_corpus.note: Serial correctness regression, not a timing benchmark. Existing baseline budget cutoffs and infeasible cases are retained explicitly; target inventory follows TB semantics.

protocol.limitations: Offline single-output normalized recipe graphs, not in-game TPS or a global optimality proof. TB counts existing target inventory toward demand; AW excludes it. The NAST case has 1206 target items already in stock.
protocol.reason_for_second_pass: The first pass showed 2.9% and 1.0% higher medians; a reverse-order replication checks reproducibility. Both passes are retained.

numeric.scope: 387 pair and 258 triple independent BigInteger-oracle checks, including extreme magnitudes; 22 public full-planner balance and objective checks

lifecycle.scope: Incomplete nonnull pair solutions not cached; completed null cache; identity and demand/limit keys; cancellation; shared work/probe denial and 64-candidate cap; equal-execution stock and net-loss checks

exact_continuation.boundary: Footprint collapse affects only ordinary long-planner branch selection. PreparedGraph retains all original routes, and planExactDiagnostic reads those routes and exact input/output amounts. FastCraftingPlanner redirects selected wide plans through ExactPlanPreview.needsExact. Do not replace the prepared route table with distinct footprint results during extraction.

limits: Bounded pair and triple search is not a general global optimality proof.
Public intermediate-gross-crosses-sentinel label names the generated family; the accepted result itself did not establish a gross-demand crossing.
Exact diagnostic continuation is bounded and marked incomplete by design; preserving alternatives does not prove general exact feasibility.
No uncoordinated benchmark or Gradle suite run in this audit.
numeric.next_review: Read-only TerminalBatchOptimizer and FCO terminal neighborhood review in tb-alpha-third-batch-20261003; no source edits.

baseline_behavior.wide_input_direct_build: returned an index despite pending interruption

footprint_cancellation.scope: Periodic checks cover explicit metadata, wide-input aggregation, canonical-term assembly, repeated pattern rows, and a final publication checkpoint. This does not bound every collection sort/copy/hash or downstream execution-safety phase to 255 operations.

confirmed_fixed.issue: MaterialDagReplay byproduct construction delayed external cancellation through the entire wide row
confirmed_fixed.public_reproduction: Existing material-DAG fixture 4192, reduced to three recipes, with 4096 unused target side outputs
confirmed_fixed.production_change: The existing slot checkpoint counter now includes byproducts at the same 256-slot interval
confirmed_fixed.tests: Two new tests fail on baseline; 66 related tests pass on the isolated candidate, including real partial input extraction

replay_and_cutoff.semantic_boundary: Self-supporting primary-demand cycles are physically executable and satisfy the current local activation inequalities. A stronger root-anchored support requirement is a future contract choice, not a proven current bug.
certificate_review: Count-vector memoization is valid for fixed ordinary recipes because remaining counts uniquely determine inventory.
Small search input/output and inventory integers are bounded by 256 plus 32 firings of at most 256 outputs.
All-orders recursion returns false on its work cutoff or checked arithmetic overflow; neither condition can certify a plan.

Each stock-backed partial batch can be linearized into enabled unit firings. Delayed provider outputs remove opportunities but cannot create an invalid unit ordering; completion restores those outputs.
Actual PartialBatchExecutionTest passed through the real AE2 inventory and TB bulkExtract path with delayed provider returns.
No independently verified false-feasible or all-orders execution error was found in this bounded review.

confirmed_fixed_budget_diagnostic.issue: Recovery exhausts the shared work allowance without marking plan.budgetExhausted or diagnostics.searchCutoff
confirmed_fixed_budget_diagnostic.public_reproduction: 16 terminal recipes formed from two distinct instances of each of the eight sample513 routes; stock A=30,B=30; target T=100
confirmed_fixed_budget_diagnostic.impact: Diagnostic loss only; no false feasible plan was observed. Missing remains the selected route's list rather than a proof of global infeasibility.
confirmed_fixed_budget_diagnostic.production_change: CraftPlannerV2 latches only actual tryConsume(false); the existing missing witness is marked through markBudgetExhausted, and PlanningDiagnostics preserves its two-argument API with a cutoff-aware overload.
confirmed_fixed_budget_diagnostic.negative_controls: Successful exact spending, naturally empty queue with exact spending, local state cap, optional deadline, and external cancellation retain their distinct handling.

budget_fix_validation.public_shared_denial: cutoff=true and budgetExhausted=true with the same Missing B=20
budget_fix_validation.public_exact_state_cap: cutoff=false and budgetExhausted=false despite 4096/4096 spending because no work request was refused

confirmed_fixed_topology_cancellation.change: Both initial indegree scan and Kahn successor fanout now checkpoint each 256 visits without reordering entries or successors
confirmed_fixed_topology_cancellation.tests: Direct certificate and public reduced-4192 paths trigger interruption only from HashMap.merge in topology, excluding add/edge construction; no id-zero assumption
confirmed_fixed_topology_cancellation.negative_controls: Old baseline: four cancellation tests fail after 4096 visits; construction-only fix: two byproduct tests pass but both topology tests still fail after 4096 visits
confirmed_fixed_topology_cancellation.candidate: 65/65 related tests pass; both topology probes observe fewer than 256 side keys after interruption; normal firing vector and stock maps match

limitations: The new terminal strategy refines feasible plans; 12 independently certified wide cases remain missing in both versions. It does not change their separate recovery path.
Among 1442 feasible wide plans, execution gaps decline from 326 to 28. The bounded pair shortlist is not a complete multi-route integer solver.
Shared-chain Pareto aggregation and fixed-prefix reuse remain research only. Larger experiments exhausted existing budgets; no limits were increased.
The primary-demand self-supporting cycle example is physically safe and follows the current local contract. No unrequested root-anchoring policy was added.
Cancellation results cover the explicitly tested loops, not every collection sort, hash, copy, or downstream safety phase.
Offline normalized recipe graphs and planning time do not establish in-game TPS or physical multi-output recipe semantics.
